title: Email Top 15 Targeted Users (Spam) with Additional Details
description: This query visualises top 15 users targeted with Spam with summarized spam detections.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Email Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Microsoft 365 Audit Logs') and ('Threat Category' like '*Spam*' and Direction = 'Inbound') | stats count as count_ by 'Target User Name' | sort -count_ | head 15 | eval Emails = count_ | fields 'Target User Name', Emails
